entities.name: Implement relational fact export
entities.summary: Project canonical entities and relations into immutable relational facts with bounded reachability and evidence queries.

acceptance: Canonical export preserves exact entity, relation, tag, attribute, and source-document row counts with valid relative source keys
Rows and nested JSON snapshots are deterministic and deeply immutable
Incoming bounded reachability from work.stm-runtime returns exact authored dependency directions and shortest paths
Evidence lookup for obligation.inventory.conformance preserves direct relation force and explicit transitive assumptions
Unknown roots, relation kinds, bounds, and source custody return typed failures
Bun and genuine Node emit byte-identical canonical report bytes
Project-model validation and generated-view checks remain green
